Issue: dinhtrung/fleet-console#2 — P0: Go module, Fiber v3 API, SQLite store, rig compat probe
Worktree: /home/dinhtrung/develop/wt-fc-2
Branch: feature/2-go-skeleton (already created from origin/main @ bd657cb)

Read first, in this order:
1. `gh issue view 2 -R dinhtrung/fleet-console --comments` — the scope and acceptance.
2. `openspec/changes/fleet-console-v1/tasks.md` tasks 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.6.
3. `openspec/changes/fleet-console-v1/design.md` §5 (architecture), §6 (data — the exact schema), §7 (rig contract).

What to build (only this):
- Go module `github.com/dinhtrung/fleet-console`, Go 1.25, layout `cmd/fleet-console`,
  `internal/{store,forge,rig,git,decide,act,web}`.
- Fiber v3 app: `/api/health`, `/api/compat`, bearer middleware, `Idempotency-Key` middleware, graceful shutdown.
- SQLite via `modernc.org/sqlite`: WAL, `busy_timeout`, migrations, single-writer guard. Schema exactly as design §6.
  There is NO queue_row, decision, lease or task table — those belong to the rig.
- Rig compat probe: `rig --version` floor (use 0.7.0 as the floor), one real `rig queue list -A -a --json` and
  `rig ps --nodes --full --json` read, required-field checks, unknown keys logged once, result exposed at
  `GET /api/compat` and by `fleet-console --compat`.

Acceptance (quote the commands and their real output in the PR):
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./...` exit 0.
- `go test ./...` green, including: store create/reopen/migrate; 401 without token / 200 with; repeated
  Idempotency-Key returns the first event_id; compat probe passes on a fixture and fails naming the field when
  `pickup_state` is renamed.
- `./fleet-console --compat` prints observed rig version, floor and both parsed shapes.

Do not: implement mirror/decide/act loops, add a web UI, or touch `src/`. If you believe the schema in design §6 is
wrong, say so on the issue instead of changing the contract.

Publishing:
- Commit with explicit paths (never `git add -A`).
- `git push -u origin feature/2-go-skeleton`
- `gh pr create --draft --base main --head feature/2-go-skeleton --title "feat(service): Go module, Fiber v3 API, SQLite store, compat probe" --body-file /home/dinhtrung/tasks/pr-2.md`
  (write the body file outside the worktree; it must contain `Closes #2`).
- Then hand off to the reviewer:
  `rig queue handoff <your-row-id> --to dev-review@fleet-console --note "candidate <sha>; gates: ...; limits: ..."`
Never merge.
summary: #2 Go module + Fiber v3 + SQLite + rig compat probe
